title: Rise of the Triad (1995) - Goin' Down the Fast Way
description:
One of the stage themes from Rise of the Triad. Based on the original 1995 version by Lee Jackson, though a few instruments are based on the 2013 remake arrangement.
Could fit athletic or castle levels.
